trip.title: Bier Reisen 2019
trip.subtitle: Munich and its surroundings, entirely by rail
trip.route_line: Munich Airport → Munich (nine nights) → Andechs → Aying → Bamberg → Munich → Munich Airport

stops.name: Munich Airport
stops.note: Land on 12 December — Airbräu is inside the airport, before the S-Bahn into town.

stops.name: Munich
stops.note: One hotel for nine nights, everything else by train: S-Bahn, U-Bahn, tram.

stops.name: Andechs
stops.note: S8 to Herrsching, then the hill — the monastery brewery and its winter beer.

stops.name: Aying
stops.note: S5 to Aying, a kilometre on foot, and the Ayinger Bräustüberl.

stops.name: Bamberg
stops.note: ICE via Nuremberg and back in a day — 250 km each way for Rauchbier.

days.title: Munich Airport → city
items: Land at Franz Josef Strauss and go straight to Airbräu, inside the airport
S-Bahn S1 or S8 into the city, 38 km / 41 min
Check in, then the historic centre: Marienplatz, Augustiner, Schneider Bräuhaus

days.title: Andechs
items: S8 to Herrsching (40 km, ~57 min), then bus 951 up the hill
Kloster Andechs: the Bräustüberl and the winter beer
Back to Munich for the evening

days.title: Aying
items: S5 towards Kreuzstraße to Aying, 32 km / 45 min
A kilometre on foot to the Ayinger Bräustüberl
Ayinger Jahrhunderthalle next door if there is a beer event on

days.title: Munich — the big three
items: Augustiner for lunch
Hofbräuhaus in the afternoon, for the room as much as the beer
Schiller Bräu in the evening

days.title: Bamberg day trip
items: ICE to Nuremberg, change, on to Bamberg — 250 km, about 3 h 20
Schlenkerla, Spezial, Fässla, Mahr's: as many as the timetable allows
Last train back to Munich

days.title: Tap House Munich
items: A slow morning, then the craft beer bar Tap House
Something on the menu from outside Bavaria for a change
Early night — the week has been long

days.title: Wine at Odeonsplatz
items: A beer-free day: the Pfälzer Weinstube at Odeonsplatz
Palatinate wines, a plate of something hearty
Walk home through the Christmas market

days.title: Giesinger Bräustüberl
items: U-Bahn to Giesing for the Giesinger Bräustüberl
Craft beer in a neighbourhood that is not on the tourist map
Back into town for the evening

days.title: Munich — free day
items: Whatever has been missed: the Viktualienmarkt, a museum, the Englischer Garten
Pack the bottles properly
Last dinner in the centre

days.title: Munich → Airport → home
items: Hotel checkout, S-Bahn to the airport, 38 km / 41 min
Airbräu again — the trip ends where it started
Flight home

legs.note: Airport line into the city, 20-minute headway.
To Herrsching, then the bus up to Kloster Andechs.
Same way back; the last S-Bahn runs late.
S5 towards Kreuzstraße, then a kilometre on foot.
Change at Nuremberg; the fast pair runs just over three hours.

Munich.name: Airbräu
Munich.note: The brewery inside Munich Airport — a copper brewhouse in the terminal, with a beer garden under the roof. The first and last stop of the trip.
Munich.order: Airbräu Helles, brewed in the copper kettles inside the terminal — the trip opens and closes here

Munich.name: Augustiner
Munich.note: Augustiner beer at Marienplatz, in the middle of the historic centre.
Munich.order: Edelstoff from the wooden barrel; the Helles if the barrel is off

Munich.name: Schneider Bräuhaus
Munich.note: Wheat-beer house on Tal: Aventinus and the original Tap 7.
Munich.order: Aventinus Weizenbock, then Tap 7 for the second round

Munich.name: Hofbräuhaus
Munich.note: The room everyone has heard of — go early, stay for the brass band.
Munich.order: Hofbräu Original by the Maß; the room is the point

Munich.name: Schiller Bräu
Munich.note: Brewpub near the station: house beers brewed on site, a modern room and a young crowd.
Munich.order: Schiller Bräu Helles, and the dark if it is on — brewed in the room

Munich.name: Tap House Munich
Munich.note: Craft beer bar with a deep tap list — the antidote to a week of Helles.
Munich.order: Whatever is hoppiest on the board — a palate reset after a week of lagers

Munich.name: Pfälzer Weinstube
Munich.note: Wine tavern at Odeonsplatz serving Palatinate wines — the one evening without beer.
Munich.order: A Pfälzer Riesling. No beer tonight, and that is the plan

Munich.name: Giesinger Bräustüberl
Munich.note: The Giesing brewery's taproom: unfiltered Helles and a neighbourhood crowd.
Munich.order: Erhellung, the unfiltered Helles, straight from the tank

Bamberg.name: Schlenkerla
Bamberg.note: Rauchbier since 1405 — beechwood smoke, oak barrels, a vaulted cellar.
Bamberg.order: Aecht Schlenkerla Rauchbier Märzen, from the oak barrel

Bamberg.name: Spezial
Bamberg.note: The Bambergers' rauchbier, softer smoke than Schlenkerla.
Bamberg.order: Spezial Rauchbier Lager — the Bambergers' own, softer smoke

Bamberg.name: Fässla
Bamberg.note: Zwergla dark lager, brewery tap opposite Spezial.
Bamberg.order: Zwergla by the half-litre, then the Lagerbier

Bamberg.name: Mahr's Bräu
Bamberg.note: The 'aU' Ungespundetes — the reference Franconian lager.
Bamberg.order: The aU at the Schwemme window, standing up

Bamberg.name: Klosterbräu
Bamberg.note: Bamberg's oldest brewery; the Schwärzla is the one to order.
Bamberg.order: Schwärzla, in the oldest brewery in town

Andechs.name: Klosterbräustüberl Andechs
Andechs.note: The monastery's own restaurant and beer hall — Doppelbock Dunkel, and a winter beer on tap from November.
Andechs.order: Doppelbock Dunkel — and the winter bier, which is why the visit is in December

Aying.name: Ayinger Bräustüberl
Aying.note: The brewery tap in the village: Jahrhundertbier, Altbairisch Dunkel, and the Ayinger range at source.
Aying.order: Jahrhundertbier, then the Celebrator Doppelbock if it is listed

Munich.subnote: One hotel for the whole trip; everything below is a U-Bahn ride or a walk.
Munich.famous: Helles, Weißbier and the big beer halls

Bamberg.subnote: 250 km each way for Rauchbier: four breweries inside the old town walls.

Andechs.subnote: The monastery hill above the Ammersee, and the Bräustüberl at the top.
Andechs.famous: Doppelbock and winter bier from the monks

Aying.subnote: A village brewery 32 km south-east, a kilometre on foot from the platform.
Aying.famous: Jahrhundertbier and the Ayinger range at source
